title: Maximum Subarray
prompt: Given an integer array `nums`, find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) which has the largest sum, and return its sum.
hints: This is Kadane's algorithm — think about what to do when the running sum goes negative.
Keep a running sum; if it drops below the current number itself, restart the subarray there.
Track a global max as you go, separate from the running sum.
